note: Message UI is the web UI for Message entities. Routes: message_ui.add_page (/message/add), message_ui.add (/message/add/{message_template}), entity.message.canonical (/message/{message}), edit/delete, and a bulk delete at /admin/config/message/message_delete_multiple. It defines static permissions (bypass message access control, update tokens, delete multiple messages, ... any message template) and a permission callback MessagePermissions::messageTemplatePermissions() that generates per-template perms 'view|update|create|delete <template_id> message'. Plugin type message_ui_views_contextual_links (plugins view/edit/delete). Depends on message + views. configure=null. Medium cases create real Message templates and read back the generated per-template permissions; hard cases create a Message entity and grant a per-template permission (both grounded in message_ui's actual behavior).

evals.prompt: Message UI provides the interface to create Message entities. What is the route/path used to create a message of a specific message template?
evals.expected_output: Route message_ui.add at /message/add/{message_template} shows the create form for that template; /message/add (message_ui.add_page) lists creatable templates and redirects if only one exists.

evals.prompt: Message UI generates permissions per message template. For a template with machine name 'example_create_node', what are the four permission names it produces?
evals.expected_output: MessagePermissions::messageTemplatePermissions() yields 'view example_create_node message', 'update example_create_node message', 'create example_create_node message', and 'delete example_create_node message'. There is also a global 'bypass message access control'.

evals.prompt: Message UI defines a plugin type used to add operation links to message rows in Views. Name the plugin type / its manager and the built-in plugin ids.
evals.expected_output: Plugin type message_ui_views_contextual_links (manager plugin.manager.message_ui_views_contextual_links, dir Plugin/MessageUiViewsContextualLinks); built-in plugins are view, edit, and delete (the message_notify_ui submodule adds notify).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a message template named 'message_ui_eval'. Because Message UI generates per-template permissions, what is the exact machine name of the permission that lets a role create a message of that template? Verify it exists on the live site.
evals.expected_output: The permission is 'create message_ui_eval message' (generated by MessagePermissions for the message_ui_eval template).

evals.prompt: A message template 'message_ui_view' exists on this site. What is the exact permission name Message UI provides to VIEW a message of that template? Confirm against the live permission list.
On this site a message template with machine name 'message_ui_hard' exists. Create a Message entity (instance) of that template and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create and save a Message of template message_ui_hard, e.g. \Drupal\message\Entity\Message::create(['template' => 'message_ui_hard'])->save(); (this is what the /message/add/message_ui_hard form does).

evals.prompt: On this site there is a message template 'message_ui_hard' and a role 'message_ui_hrole'. Grant that role the Message UI permission that allows creating messages of that specific template, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Grant the permission 'create message_ui_hard message' to role message_ui_hrole (e.g. drush role:perm:add message_ui_hrole 'create message_ui_hard message').
